Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Pull Apart Garlic Bread  Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 1 tbsp sugar * 270g milk (about 1 cup + 2 tbsp) * 380g flour (about 3 cups) * 1 tsp salt * 43g softened butter (about 3 tbsp) Butter Mixture * 100g butter, softened * 1 tbsp chopped cilantro * 1 garlic clove, minced * Shredded cheese Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the sugar and yeast. Add the milk, then add the flour and mix until combined. 2. Add the salt and softened butter, then coil fold until the butter is fully incorporated. 3. Cover and let the dough rest for 2 hours or until doubled. 4. Mix the softened butter with the cilantro and minced garlic. 5. Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread the garlic butter mixture evenly over it. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese. 6. Cut the dough in half, stack one half on top of the other, then cut into strips. Transfer the pieces into a loaf pan. 7. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. 8. Bake at 370°F for 30 minutes, or until golden brown. 9. Brush with the remaining garlic butter mixture while still warm. #bread #garlicbread #breadtok #baking #homemadebread

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Garlic Butter Spaghetti 🔥 Quick, easy, and dangerously good. Buttery garlic heaven with a hint of spice… Pro Tip: Level it up with chicken, shrimp, or tofu 🫡 Ingredients: -2 shallots, thinly sliced -5 garlic cloves, minced -2 tbsp chili crisp -1 cup of cream or coconut milk, room temperature -1 tbsp soy sauce, optional -1/2 cup fresh Parmesan cheese, grated -8 oz (225g) pasta of your choice -2 tbsp butter -1 tbsp olive oil -Seasonings (1 tsp each): paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, oregano 1. Slice your shallots nice and thin and measure out your seasonings. Bring your cream or coconut milk to room temp so it blends in smoothly later. 2. Heat 2 tbsp butter + 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Add the shallots and sauté for 8–10 minutes until soft and starting to turn golden. 3. While the shallots are doing their thing, bring a big pot of salted water to a boil and cook your pasta until al dente. Drain, but save some pasta water… it’s liquid gold. Seriously, don’t you dare dump it. Italians everywhere are watching. 4. Once the shallots are soft and sweet, stir in your minced garlic (fresh garlic only - if you pull out that jarred stuff, the FBI will be at your door in minutes 😅) and all the seasonings. Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. Hot Honey Chicken Pasta 🍯🔥 the viral recipe with over 60+ million views, 20/10 hits every time! Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

videos.caption: Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Warm up sauce in a pan, serve on a wrap with fresh lettuce and enjoy . . . . #garlicparmesan #chickenwrap #chickenrecipes #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Steak Loaded Potato Skins🔥 For those of you asking about the app, just search “Osta” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 Crispy, cheesy potato skins loaded with juicy steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives… 🤤 Inspo from the goats @chefmikekubiesa & @burnt_pellet_bbq !! For the Potatoes: -5 large russet potatoes -1/4 cup olive oil -1 tbsp salt For the Filling: -Scooped potato flesh -1/2 cup milk, warmed -1/3 cup butter, softened -1/2 cup sour cream -1 1/2 cups sharp cheddar, grated -1/4 cup fresh chives, chopped -Seasoning salt, to taste For Frying & Topping: -Neutral oil, for frying -Triple cheddar @tillamook, grated For the Steak: -Ribeye or New York strip -Salt & black pepper For the Chipotle Sour Cream (Optional): -1 cup sour cream -1–2 chipotle peppers in adobo -2 garlic cloves -1 tbsp lime juice -1/2 tsp salt -Milk, as needed Instructions: 1. Wash & dry potatoes. Rub with olive oil, season with salt & bake at 425°F (220°C) for 50–60 mins until fork-tender. Let cool slightly. 2. Meanwhile, blend all chipotle sour cream ingredients until smooth, adding a splash of milk to thin as needed. Refrigerate. 3. Halve potatoes lengthwise & scoop the flesh into a bowl, leaving about 1/4 inch around the skins. Mash with warm milk, butter, sour cream, cheddar, chives & seasoning salt to taste. 4. Heat neutral oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry the empty skins in batches for 2–3 mins until golden & crispy, then transfer to a wire rack. 5. Stuff the skins with the potato filling, top with triple cheddar & bake at 350°F (175°C) for 15 mins until bubbling & golden. 6. Season steak generously with salt & pepper, then grill or pan-sear to your desired doneness. Rest 5–10 mins, then slice against the grain into bite-sized pieces. 7. Load the skins with steak, chipotle sour cream & fresh chives. Enjoy!! #dinnerideas #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #cooking

Chicken Bacon Ranch Pasta Bake INGREDIENTS  1 lb of Cellentani Pasta  1 lb cooked chicken (rotisserie chicken) 15 oz jar of Alfredo Sauce 1 Ranch seasoning packet  1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese 1 1/2 cups of shredded mozzarella cheese 6 pieces of cooked and crumbled bacon Parsley INSTRUCTIONS  Cook at least 6 pieces of bacon and chop into small pieces. Viralowe pierożki z patelni – chrupiące od spodu i obłędnie soczyste w środku! Jeśli lubisz azjatyckie smaki, koniecznie zapisz ten przepis. Z podanych składników przygotujesz 2 duże porcje. SKŁADNIKI: 20 płatów ciasta do pierożków dim sum 500 g mielonej wieprzowiny 1 marchewka duża garść szczypiorku 6 ząbków czosnku 1 łyżka startego imbiru 2 łyżki sosu sojowego 2 łyżki sosu ostrygowego 1 łyżka oleju sezamowego 1 łyżeczka cukru trzcinowego 1 łyżeczka soli 125 ml bulionu warzywnego PRZYGOTOWANIE: 1. Marchewkę zetrzyj, szczypiorek drobno posiekaj, a czosnek przeciśnij przez praskę. 2. Do mielonej wieprzowiny dodaj marchewkę, szczypiorek, czosnek i starty imbir. 3. Dodaj sos sojowy, sos ostrygowy, olej sezamowy, cukier trzcinowy i sól. Całość dokładnie wymieszaj. 4. Porcję farszu nakładaj na środek ciasta do dim sum i dokładnie zlepiaj pierożki. 5. Pierożki ułóż na patelni i podsmażaj na średnim ogniu przez około 2 minuty, aż spód zacznie się rumienić. 6. Wlej 125 ml bulionu warzywnego, przykryj patelnię i gotuj przez około 16 minut. 7. Zdejmij pokrywkę i gotowe! Najlepiej smakują polane olejem chili lub dodatkowym sosem sojowym. WARTOŚCI ODŻYWCZE NA 1 PORCJĘ: 825 kcal 62 g białka 39 g tłuszczu 57 g węglowodanów 4 g błonnika Chrupiący spód, miękkie ciasto i aromatyczny, soczysty farsz. Zdecydowanie jeden z tych przepisów, które warto zapisać! Zapisz i wyślij komuś, z kim zjadłbyś całą patelnię! #food #foodtok #cooking #recipe #dumplings

Blanket Dumplings 🥟 These dumplings definitely live up to the hype. They’re by far the quickest and easiest way to make homemade dumplings, and you can have them on the table in under 25 minutes. If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that save you time and money. Follow for more Weeknight Staples. Ingredients • 1 lb ground pork • 1/3 cup green onions, thinly sliced • 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated • 4 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp oyster sauce • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tbsp chili crisp • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1½ tsp sesame oil • 1 tbsp rice vinegar • 18–20 dumpling wrappers • 1/4 cup chicken broth • Avocado oil For Topping • Soy sauce • Chili crisp • Green onions • Sesame seeds Instructions 1. In a bowl, combine the ground pork, green onions, grated ginger, garlic, oyster sauce, black pepper, chili crisp, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar. Mix until fully combined. 2. Use a cookie scoop to place mounds of the filling onto a sheet pan, leaving enough space between each one. 3. Place a dumpling wrapper over each mound and pinch the edges around the filling to seal. 4. Drizzle with avocado oil, pour in the chicken broth, cover, and steam for 10 minutes, or until the pork reaches an internal temperature of 160°F. 5. Top with soy sauce, chili crisp, green onions, and sesame seeds before serving with a side of rice. #easydinners #dumpling #blanketdumplings

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

Chicken Parmesan 🧀🍗 Prep: 10m | Cook: 10m | Serves: 1-2 Ingredients: The Cutlet: 1 large chicken breast (butterflied & pounded even) Rub: 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp black pepper, salt to taste Breading:  1/4 cup flour | 2 beaten eggs | 1 cup Panko + 1 tsp dried parsley Oil for frying Sauce & Cheese: 1.5 cups marinara sauce 1 cup shredded mozzarella Method: 1. Pre-heat Oven to 350F. 2. Prep & Season: Butterfly chicken, pound even, and rub thoroughly with garlic powder, pepper, and salt. 3. Bread: Dredge in flour ➔ submerge in egg ➔ press firmly into parsley-Panko. 4. Fry: Cook in hot oil (or deep fry) for 3–4 mins per side until deep golden (165°F). Move to a wire rack. 5. Melt: Spread marinara on an oven-safe plate, cover with mozzarella, and bake until mozzarella cheese is melted. Broil for last 3-4 minutes until bubbly and browned. 6. Pour-Over: Drop cutlet onto the hot plate and slide the molten cheese and sauce over the top. Serve immediately! #asmr #recipe #cooking #foodtok

Seeing the before and after of this build progress makes all the hard work totally worth it! Nashville Hot Chicken Mac & Cheese  Recipe ⬇️ Ridiculously creamy four-cheese mac and cheese with a crispy golden cheese crust, topped with crunchy fried chicken coated in a spicy Nashville hot oil! Mac & Cheese 16 oz cavatappi pasta 4 tbsp butter 4 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup whole milk 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 8 oz mozzarella 4 oz Fontina 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp Dijon mustard ½ tsp chicken bouillon Salt & black pepper Reserved pasta water Fried Chicken 2 lb chicken tenderloins 2 cups buttermilk 2 tbsp hot sauce 2 cups flour ½ cup cornstarch 1 tbsp paprika 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & cayenne Salt & black pepper Oil for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 2 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp chili powder ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp salt Directions Cook pasta 1–2 minutes shy of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Melt butter, whisk in flour and cook 1–2 minutes. Slowly add evaporated milk, cream, milk and seasonings. Simmer until slightly thickened. Reduce heat to low and melt in 16 oz of the shredded cheese. Reserve the other 16 oz for layering. Fold in pasta, adding reserved pasta water as needed to keep it extra creamy. Layer half the mac in a baking dish, add 6 oz reserved cheese, then remaining mac and 10 oz cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 20–25 minutes, then broil 1–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Marinate chicken in buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 30 minutes. Mix flour, cornstarch and seasonings, then coat chicken thoroughly. Fry chicken at 350°F for 4–6 minutes until crispy and 165°F internally. Combine Nashville hot oil spices in a heatproof bowl. Carefully pour ½ cup hot frying oil over the spices and stir until combined. Brush or toss the fried chicken in Nashville hot oil, then pile it over the baked mac and cheese. Enjoy! 🔥 #nashvillehotchicken #macandcheese #friedchicken #comfortfood #recipe

Christmas Sugar Cookie Bars 🎄✨ (recipe makes an 8x8 pan)  Ingredients: ½ cup (113g) unsalted butter, room temp 2 oz (56g) cream cheese, room temp 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar  1 egg, room temp 1½ tsp vanilla  ¼ tsp almond extract 1⅔ cups (210g) all-purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in)  ½ tsp baking powder ½ tsp salt Frosting: 4 tbsp (57g) unsalted butter, room temp 1⅓ (160g) cups powdered sugar  1-2 tbsp milk or heavy cream (adjust for desired consistency)  ½ tsp vanilla Pinch of salt + christmas sprinkles for topping! Instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease/line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper.  Beat butter, cream cheese, and sugar together until combined. Then, add the egg, vanilla, and almond extract and mix until fully combined.  In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt, then gently fold into the wet ingredients until just combined.  Spread evenly into the prepared pan, smoothing out the top.  Bake for 20-25 minutes, until the edges are set or a toothpick inserted comes out clean/mostly clean.  Let it cool completely.  For the frosting, beat the butter until creamy, then mix in the powdered sugar, milk, vanilla, and salt until smooth/spreadable.  Spread over the completely cooled bars and decorate with christmas sprinkles. Enjoy! ✨ #bakingrecipe #sugarcookies #christmascookies #christmasbaking #christmasrecipe

Meals for Weight-loss:  Mexican Chicken Corn Salad Ingredients:  Chicken * Chicken breast, 800 g * Lime juice, 2 tbsp * Avocado oil, 1 tbsp * Chili powder, 2 tsp * Cumin, 1.5 tsp * Garlic powder, 1 tsp * Paprika, 1 tsp * Salt, 1 tsp * Black pepper, 0.5 tsp Veggies * Cotija cheese, 50 g * Red onion, 1 large, finely diced * Red bell pepper, 1 large, finely diced * Cilantro, 1 handful, chopped * Jalapeños, 3, finely diced * Canned corn, 2 cups total, drained and charred Sauce * Plain 0% Greek yogurt, 1 cup * Lime juice, from 0.5 lime * Hot sauce, 1 tbsp * Tajín, 1 tbsp * Water, 0.5 cup * Salt, to taste * Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add it to a bowl with lime juice, avocado oil, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Mix well and marinate for 15 to 30 minutes. 2. Heat a large pan on medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned and fully cooked to 165°F. 3. Drain the canned corn really well and pat it dry with paper towel. In the same pan or a clean hot pan, add the corn in a single layer and let it sit untouched for 2 to 3 minutes, then stir and cook another 2 to 3 minutes until charred in spots. 4. In a bowl, mix Greek yogurt, lime juice, hot sauce, Tajín, water, salt, and black pepper until smooth. 5. In a large bowl, add the charred corn, red onion, red bell pepper, cilantro, jalapeños, and cotija cheese. 6. Pour in the sauce and mix everything until coated. 7. Divide the chicken and street corn salad mixture into 4 servings. Store chilled and eat within 3 to 4 days. Nutrition (Per Serving, 4 servings) * Calories: 475 * Protein: 58g * Carbs: 30g * Fat: 18g #homecooking #easyrecipe #chicken #sesamechicken #takeout

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Enjoy! #dinner #easyrecipe #homecooking #tiktokrecipe #fyp #shawarma #chickenrecipe #cookingathometiktoktv

In a small bowl, whisk together all of the sauce ingredients until smooth. Pour most of the sauce over the chicken, reserving about ¼ cup for later. Coat the chicken evenly. 4. Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

This has definitely been added to my weekly rotation 🤤 Ingredients Chicken 4-5 chicken thighs 1 tsp black pepper  ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp smoked paprika (optional) 1/2 tsp dried thyme (optional) 1 tbsp olive oil Creamy Pepper Sauce 1/2 white onion, very finely chopped 3 garlic cloves minced  2 tbsp crushed peppercorns  1/4 tsp rosemary  150 ml chicken stock 100 ml double cream 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1 tbsp butter Salt, to taste Extra crushed black pepper, if needed Parsley chopped  Crispy Baby Potatoes baby potatoes 1–1½ tbsp olive oil Salt Black pepper 1/4 tsp dried thyme  1/4 tsp rosemary 1 tbsp butter 1/2 tsp garlic Method  Potatoes Groove the baby potatoes with a wedge cutter. Boil in salted water for 6–8 minutes, then drain and steam-dry. Toss with oil, salt, pepper and herbs. Air fry at 190°C for 15 minutes, shake, then 200°C for 5–8 minutes. Add butter and crushed garlic for the last 2–3 minutes. Chicken Pat the thighs dry and apply the prepared seasoning. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes per side, until cooked through. Remove and rest. Pepper Sauce In the same pan, add 1 tbsp butter and finely chopped white onion and garlic. Cook for 2–3 minutes. Add in the crushed peppercorns, add the chicken stock, scrape the pan and simmer for 2–3 minutes. Add the mustard, Worcestershire sauce and rosemary. Stir in the double cream, simmer for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. Return the chicken to the sauce for 1–2 minutes. Sprinkle chopped parsley if using. 15 MINUTE CREAMY THAI COCONUT COD CURRY  Creamy, fragrant and properly speedy. The cod steams gently in the curry sauce to become perfectly flakey and gorgeous. The PERFECT midweek meal.  Serves 2 at approx 490kcal & 26g protein per portion   1 pack microwave brown rice 1 carrot 1 courgette 2 cod fillets (or any protein of choice)  1 tin light or full fat coconut milk 1 tbsp red curry paste 2 spring onions 1 tsp honey 1 chicken stock cube 1 tsp fish sauce 1 tsp soy sauce  Lime & Crispy chilli oil to serve   Dry the cod and salt.   Add the light coconut milk, red curry paste, spring onions, honey, stock cube, fish sauce and soy sauce to a blender and blitz until smooth.  Julienne the carrot and courgette, or peel into ribbons.  Add the rice to a wide pan, top with the veg, then place the cod on top. Add the cucumber, red onion, chicken, parsley, half of the feta cheese, 1 tbsp of parmesan, half of the crispy corn and the dressing. Toss together. 6. Serve in a bowl, top with the remaining feta, corn and 1 tbsp of parmesan. Enjoy on it’s own or with some tortilla chips on the side. videos.caption: Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

The Arctic Fox (Vulpes lagopus), sometimes called the snow fox, is a small but remarkably hardy fox adapted to some of the coldest environments on Earth. Its thick fur changes with the seasons white during winter to blend into snow and brown or grey in summer to camouflage against rocks and vegetation. Its compact body, short ears, and furry paws help conserve heat in freezing conditions. Arctic foxes are symbols of adaptability, resilience, intelligence, and survival. They inhabit Arctic tundra across the Northern Hemisphere and can withstand temperatures far below freezing while searching for rodents, birds, eggs, fish, and carrion. Fun fact: An Arctic fox can survive temperatures approaching −50°C (−58°F), partly because its thick winter coat provides exceptional insulation. #ArcticFox #SnowFox #VulpesLagopus #Wildlife #Winter

Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🍗 For all of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store ‼️🫶 The crispiest korean porocrn chicken… sweet, spicy and so simple. You can also make this in the air fryer!!🔥 For the Chicken: -2 lb chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1 inch cubes -2 eggs -2 tbsp rice vinegar -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp gochugaru (optional) -1/4 cup cornstarch -1/2 cup all-purpose flour -Neutral oil, for frying For the Sauce: -1.5 tbsp gochujang -2 tsp sesame seeds -3 tbsp ketchup -4 garlic cloves, minced -1.5 tbsp honey -3 tbsp butter -1 tbsp rice vinegar -1 tbsp soy sauce -2 tsp sesame oil -1 tsp gochugaru (optional) Garnish: -Sesame seeds -Green onions, sliced Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine chicken with eggs, vinegar, garlic, ginger, & seasonings. Mix well & marinate as long as you wish (1 hour ideal, 1 min works). →For frying: add the cornstarch & flour directly into the same bowl and mix until evenly coated & sticky. →For air frying: do NOT add flour yet. You’ll coat it separately in step 2. 2. For frying: skip this step & go to step 3. For air frying: in a new bowl, mix cornstarch & flour. Remove chicken from marinade then toss in dry ingredients until fully coated. Press lightly so it sticks. 3. For frying: heat neutral oil to 350°F / 175°C. Fry in batches for 7–8 mins until golden and crispy, transfer to a rack. 4. For air frying: oil the basket & spray/brush the chicken with oil. Cook at 375°F for 8 mins, flip, cook for 6–8 mins more until crispy & cooked through. Work in batches. 5. In a pan over medium-low heat, combine gochujang, ketchup, sesame seeds, garlic, honey, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, & optional gochugaru. Bring to a simmer, add butter, stir until melted, remove from heat. 6. Add the chicken directly to the sauce & toss OR in a mixing bowl, combine your desired amount of sauce with the chicken to control how saucy it gets. 7. Serve over jasmine rice, garnish with sesame seeds & green onions. Enjoy :) #recipesoftiktok #chicken #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Bacon Wrapped Carrots with a Maple Dijon Glaze 🥕🥓 the side dish you need to add to your Thanksgiving menu this year! The key step is to roast them on a wire rack so the bacon gets super crispy all around and anything that burns drips onto the aluminum foil for easy cleanup. These are absolutely delicious!  Search ‘crowded kitchen bacon wrapped carrots’ online for the full recipe or head straight here: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/bacon-wrapped-carrots/ 10 medium carrots about 8 inches long, peeled 10 slices regular-cut bacon Glaze:  3 tablespoons pure maple syrup 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 1 tablespoon olive oil ½ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon smoked paprika ¼ teaspoon dried thyme ¼ teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar Preheat the oven to 400˚F/200˚C. Set a wire rack over an aluminum foil-lined sheet pan. To a large pot of boiling water, add the whole carrots and blanch for 6 to 7 minutes (about 4 for thin carrots, 8 to 9 for extra-thick ones). Drain and pat completely dry. Starting at the thick end of the carrot, wrap one slice of bacon around each carrot in a spiral. Space the turns so a stripe of carrot shows between each one, with no overlap. At each end, push a toothpick all the way through the bacon and the carrot so it comes out through the bacon on the other side. Lay the carrots on the rack. Place the carrots in the oven for 10, until the fat in the bacon starts to render. Meanwhile, whisk together the maple syrup, honey, Dijon, olive oil, kosher salt, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper and apple cider vinegar until well combined. Brush the top side of the carrots with about ⅓ of the glaze, then return to the oven and cook another 10-12 minutes. Flip the carrots, brush the side now facing up with another ⅓ of the glaze, and return to the oven for another 10-12 minutes. Flip again, brush with the remaining glaze, and cook a final 10-12 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the glaze is glossy and set. Test for doneness by sliding a paring knife into the thickest part of a carrot. If it goes in easily, they're done. If not, return them to the oven for 5 more minutes, laying a sheet of foil loosely over the top if the bacon is already crisp. Let rest for 5 minutes so the glaze can set, then remove the toothpicks and finish with herbs. Don't leave the carrots on the wire rack for more than 5 to 10 minutes, or the glaze can make them hard to remove.

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Here are three easy rotisserie chicken meals that are in my dinner rotation.  Just pick up a rotisserie chicken, or two, or three and make a meal prep out of it. I tried a new red enchilada sauce and it was seriously delicious. I was skeptical about the peanut butter, but then I was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it tasted. My entire family loved it!  Here are the recipes and instructions.  *Chicken Alfredo  3 tablespoons salted butter 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon onion powder 4 cups heavy cream 1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, plus more to taste 1 tbsp parsley leaves 16 oz penne pasta  3-4 cups shredded chicken  1 broccoli head, cut into bite sized pieces    1. Cook pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, stirring occasionally.  2. While the pasta cooks, in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the garlic and onion powder and whisk for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Whisk in the cream and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and add the Parmesan. Whisk until the cheese is melted into the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes. Be careful not to let the sauce boil. Turn off the heat then season with salt and pepper. Add more if needed.  3. Add chicken, broccoli and pasta and toss until everything is coated.  Optional: add red pepper flakes for a little kick  *Chicken Noodle Soup  3 cups shredded chicken  3 Tbsp avocado oil  2 medium carrots,  sliced into thin circles 4 large sticks of celery, finely diced 1 small/medium onion, finely diced 8 cups chicken stock  4 cups water 4 medium potatoes,  peeled and cubed  2 bay leaves 2 Tbsp parsley 1 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 1/2 cups egg noodle pasta, or use 3/4 cup small pasta  1 garlic glove, minced  Directions: 1. In a large soup pot over medium- high heat, add 2 Tbsp olive oil. Once oil is hot, add onions, carrots, and celery and sauté until softened and golden, stirring frequently for 5-7 minutes.  2. Add broth, water, potatoes, bay leaf, 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Bring to a boil and continue cooking at a medium boil for 10 minutes 3. Add pasta and chicken and cook for 5 minutes or until pasta and potatoes are tender. Add more salt and pepper to taste. 4. Press in 1 garlic clove and stir in parsley then remove from heat and enjoy.  *Green Sauce Enchiladas  15-20 corn tortillas (you can make as many or little as you want)  28 ounce can of Las Palmas Green Chile Enchilada Sauce  Avocado oil (enough to cover the bottom of a pan)  1/4 of an onion, diced  2 tsp dried oregano  1 to 2 cups shredded chicken  3/4 tbsps white vinegar  Directions: 1. Add oil to a pan and heat on medium/low heat.  2. Take a stack of 5-10 tortillas, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for a minute. Just enough to soften so they don't break when handled.  3. Once oil is hot, add the tortillas one by one and allow them to lightly fry (2 to 3 seconds) then remove from oil and place them on paper towels to drain.  4. Heat sauce in a medium sized sauce pan on low and bring to a simmer. Remove and set aside. 5. Chop 1/4 cup onion and add about 3/4 tbsp of white vinegar and dried oregano. Mix to combine and set aside.  Assemble: To eat right away- -dip oiled tortillas into sauce. Add shredded chicken and about 1 tsp of the onion, oregano, vinegar mixture then roll up tightly and place in pan with the seam side down. Repeat process with the remaining tortillas.  When you plate them, top with shredded lettuce, queso fresco, and a few slices of avocado. You can also add sour cream and hot sauce. 😉 To freeze them and serve later- *prepare everything the same way but DO NOT add the sauce. Heat and add the sauce when you are ready to eat them.  *Red Sauce Enchiladas  Recipe in comments. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

High Protein Cheesy & Creamy Garlic Chicken Quesadillas🍗🧀🧄 68g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 Don’t forget to check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes just like this👨🏻‍🍳 (Macros: Per Quesadilla - 10 Total) 468 Calories 23gC | 15gF | 68gP Ingredients:  1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tbsp All Purpose Seasoning 1 Tsp Olive Oil 100ml Chicken Broth 8 Diced Garlic Cloves 350ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 1.5 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder (Vegeta) & 1 Tsp Oregano 100g Light Cream Cheese 40g Freshly Grated Parmesan Cheese Chopped Spinach 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Large Tortillas) 50g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (per quesadilla - Dairyworks Natural Cheddar Cheese) Instructions: 1. Start by seasoning your chicken breast with all purpose seasoning (or your choice of seasonings) add a drizzle of olive oil & mix well. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side with a lid on top or until fully cooked through. Once cooked set aside. 3. Deglaze the pan with chicken broth then add diced garlic, let it cook & add fat free evaporated milk along with smoked paprika, chicken stock powder, oregano, light cream cheese, grated parmesan cheese & stir well until smooth & creamy.  4. Add chopped spinach to the sauce & let it simmer on low heat, while simmering shred the chicken apart using 2 forks then place the shredded chicken back into the pan. 5. Mix the creamy garlic sauce & chicken well to combine. 6. Place down a warm tortilla, add light cheddar cheese to one half of the tortilla along with a portion of the filling, another layer of cheddar & fold the tortilla over.  7. Toast the quesadilla on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas & enjoy! #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Sazonamos los muslos de pollo con sal, pimienta negra, 4 cucharadas de Sazonador Spanglish Asadero Chipotle Chicken y 2 cucharadas de paprika. Mezclamos muy bien hasta que todo el pollo quede perfectamente sazonado. 2. Llevamos el pollo a la parrilla o a un sartén y cocinamos hasta que esté completamente cocido y bien doradito. Incorporamos el aderezo y mezclamos muy bien hasta que todos los ingredientes queden perfectamente cubiertos. 8. Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. Roast at 425°F until browned + crisp around the edges. Full recipes on Substack! #m#mealprepm#mealprepideass#sheetpandinnerk#kebabsc#chipotleC@ChipotleS@Sur La Table

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! 9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

Serve: Garnish with fresh parsley if desired. hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken
